request.query: sum arithmetic progression in a linear ordered field finite range lower bound

items.name: Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) (m n : ℕ),
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m n, f k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - m), f (m + k)

items.name: Finset.sum_range_le_sum
items.type: ∀ {s : Finset ℤ} {c : ℤ}, (∀ x ∈ s, c ≤ x) → ∑ n ∈ Finset.range s.card, (c + ↑n) ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, x

items.name: Finset.sum_Ico_add_eq_sum_Ico_add_one
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {a b : α} [inst_1 : LinearOrder α]
  [inst_2 : LocallyFiniteOrder α] [inst_3 : AddMonoidWithOne α] [SuccAddOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α],
  a ≤ b → ∀ (f : α → M), ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f x + f b = ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico a (b + 1), f x

items.name: Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub
items.type:
∀ {δ : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommGroup δ] (f : ℕ → δ) {m n : ℕ},
  m ≤ n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m n, f k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, f k

items.name: Finset.sum_range_succ'
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ),
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f (k + 1) + f 0

items.name: Finset.sum_range_eq_add_Ico
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) {n : ℕ},
  0 < n → ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, f x = f 0 + ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, f x
